profiles.title: AI Engineer
profiles.headline: AI Engineer | RAG Pipelines, AI Agents & LLMOps
profiles.summary: Engineer turned teacherpreneur turned engineer again, shipping production LLM systems: RAG pipelines, vector search, and multi-agent workflows on LangChain and LangGraph, served through FastAPI REST APIs on PostgreSQL. Co-founded YourCompany, where lesson generation went from hours to seconds. Now Engineering AI Specialist at YourClient, leading the rollout of AI-as-Infrastructure across CI/CD pipelines and developer harnesses for 8 engineering and data teams delivering banking services at YourClient | YourClient. A decade in classrooms taught me who the system serves; engineering taught me how to build it.
